name: push_in
description: A push in or out on each talking-head clip, one call: each main-track clip's scale keyed 1.00 to 1.07 across it (every other one from 1.04, so a cut changes the framing), the face kept in place; style alternate pushes in, then out, clip to clip (more energy, never a rule). A clip a person framed is left alone. A human edit since the read is refused.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {pushed (clips), kept? (clips a person framed, left alone), noFace? (clips anchored at 0.35, no face seen)}. detail adds the pushed ids.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: items
params.description: Only these clips: a JSON list of item ids. Default: every video on the main track.

params.name: zoom
params.description: How much each clip grows across it (0.07 is 7%; default 0.07, alternate 0.09).

params.name: anchor
params.description: What stays put: a share of the height (0.35, the default), face (each clip's head) or follow (keyed along the head).

params.name: style
params.description: push (default): every clip pushes in; alternate: in, then out, clip to clip.
